name: Vinyl Holy Grail Finder
objective: Find genuinely underpriced or hard-to-find vinyl relative to a user's exact target and verified market evidence, then turn successful discovery into a paid sourcing service.

commercial_offer.promise: A ranked shortlist of real vinyl listings matching your target, with edition clues, asking price, shipping, source, comparable evidence and estimated buy-worthiness.
commercial_offer.fulfilment: Digital shortlist; no purchase is made on the customer's behalf without explicit authorization.

kill_rule: Do not scale the service until at least one real user independently confirms a useful find and the economics of fulfilment are recorded.
next_action: Build target schema + scanner/parser + evidence report against public NZ vinyl listings.
